ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

2. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. quickly
   C. blue
   D. happiness

3. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only an action

4. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

5. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.

6. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

7. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. went
   C. going
   D. goes

8. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

9. When practising Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.

10. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.

11. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.

12. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.

13. When practising Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.

14. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. where is the library

15. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for : Stressed and unstressed words.
   B. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.

   D. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.
